Hero.sub: BenHub digitalizes the entire construction logistics chain — from vehicle dispatch, fleet management to real-time financial reconciliation.

Problem.desc: Construction logistics still relies on paper slips, phone calls, and Excel sheets. As vehicle counts, routes, and contractors multiply, inefficiencies become a systemic cost problem.
Problem.radar_label: The biggest cost leaks in current operations.
Problem.loss_detail: Could lose VND 5–20B without GPS proof, E-Ticket, and automated reconciliation.
Problem.p1_desc: Short-loaded trucks, phantom trips, forged slips. Costs disappear before detection.
Problem.p2_desc: Calling each driver, messaging each trip on Zalo. Once you hit 50 vehicles, everything falls apart.
Problem.p3_desc: Paper slips are easy to lose, alter, and hard to trace. Reconciliation depends on people and trust.
Problem.p4_desc: Investors pay late, contractors owe fleet owners, fleet owners owe drivers. Cash flow locked 30–90 days.
Problem.p5_desc: No dashboard, no GPS, no AI. No one knows exactly where vehicles are or what the real progress is.
Problem.insight_title: Not lacking vehicles. Lacking a trustworthy operations layer.
Problem.insight_desc: When all data is scattered in paperwork, calls and messages, businesses can't optimize their fleet or protect margins.

Solution.s1_before: Paper slips — easy to forge, easy to lose
Solution.s2_after: AI Smart Dispatch — automated optimal vehicle assignment
Solution.s3_after: Realtime GPS Tracking — full fleet visibility
Solution.s5_after: BenHub Finance — advance payment after delivery
Solution.tagline: BenHub — The digital operating system for construction logistics.
Solution.s6_before: Paper weighbridge slips, scattered ledgers and spreadsheets
Solution.s6_after: BenHub Mine — tickets, output and receivables in one system

HowItWorks.desc: 6 operational steps, fully digital — no paper, no phone calls.
HowItWorks.s1_desc: The investor or general contractor creates an order on BenHub Core: trip count, material type, pickup-delivery points, schedule. System auto-calculates vehicles needed.
HowItWorks.s1_h1: Enter order online, no calls needed
HowItWorks.s2_desc: BenHub automatically matches the best-fit fleet: nearest, correct capacity, high rating, available schedule. No phone calls. AI optimizes routes and costs.
HowItWorks.s3_desc: Driver receives notification via app, confirms, activates GPS. E-Ticket auto-generated with QR code, time + coordinate watermark.
HowItWorks.s3_h2: Digital E-Ticket with QR code auto-created
HowItWorks.sm_desc: Trucks check in at the quarry, get weighed and receive a digital weighbridge ticket from BenHub Mine. Sales output is recorded right away; customer receivable documents are generated periodically from completed tickets.
HowItWorks.sm_h1: Truck check-in/check-out at the quarry gate
HowItWorks.sm_h2: Digital weighbridge ticket — confirmed by the customer in-system
HowItWorks.sm_h3: Receivables generated periodically from completed tickets
HowItWorks.s4_desc: Supervisor monitors the entire fleet on map. Instant detection of route deviations, unusual stops, underloading. Immediate in-app alerts.
HowItWorks.s4_h2: Auto alerts: route deviation, unusual stops
HowItWorks.s5_desc: When trip completes: system auto-aggregates volume, compares order vs actuals, generates reports, updates payables instantly.

DriverPage.meta_title: Register as Driver | BenHub — Get Consistent Trips
DriverPage.meta_desc: Join BenHub's driver network — consistent daily trips, digital E-Ticket, advance payment without waiting.
DriverPage.hero_sub: BenHub connects dump truck drivers with thousands of trips from major infrastructure projects. Digital E-Ticket, GPS tracking and fast advance — no middlemen, no waiting.
DriverPage.hero_card_sub: Operate your fleet like a real business
DriverPage.hero_f1: Consistent trips — no reliance on middlemen
DriverPage.hero_f2: Digital E-Ticket — never lose a slip
DriverPage.benefits_heading: Everything a driver needs to operate better.
DriverPage.benefits_sub: BenHub isn't just a ride app — it's the digital infrastructure for your entire operation.
DriverPage.b1_desc: Smart Dispatch automatically coordinates, no need to wait for middlemen. Your vehicle never sits idle for more than 1 day.
DriverPage.b2_desc: View revenue realtime in the app, know exactly how much each trip pays. No hidden deductions.
DriverPage.b3_desc: Every trip has a digital E-Ticket with QR code and GPS proof. Never lose a slip, never argue about volume.
DriverPage.b4_desc: No waiting until end of month. BenHub Finance supports early advance as soon as the trip is verified.
DriverPage.b5_desc: Every journey has timestamps and GPS coordinates. Clear evidence protects you in any dispute.
DriverPage.b6_desc: BenHub operations team is always ready to help when incidents occur. You never handle it alone.
DriverPage.step_1_desc: Fill in the registration form in just 2 minutes — name, phone number, license plate and operating area.
DriverPage.step_2_desc: Operations team will call back within 24h to confirm vehicle info, area and suitable schedule.
DriverPage.step_3_desc: Install BenHub Driver, receive dispatch orders. GPS activates automatically, E-Ticket created when trip starts.
DriverPage.step_4_desc: Automatic reconciliation after each trip. Can advance early or receive periodic payment via BenHub Finance.
DriverPage.faq_1_a: Completely free. BenHub charges no registration fee. Just fill in the form and wait for the operations team to contact you.
DriverPage.faq_2_q: What type of driving license do I need?
DriverPage.faq_2_a: BenHub accepts drivers with B2 license and above. C, D, F preferred for heavy trucks and dump trucks.
DriverPage.faq_3_q: I drive for a company — can I register individually?
DriverPage.faq_3_a: You can register as an independent driver if the vehicle is personally owned. For company vehicles, owner confirmation is needed.
DriverPage.faq_4_q: How and when does BenHub pay?
DriverPage.faq_4_a: Each completed trip is auto-reconciled. BenHub Finance supports early advance or periodic payment as agreed.
DriverPage.faq_5_q: I'm in a remote province — can I join?
DriverPage.faq_5_a: BenHub is expanding nationwide, prioritizing provinces with major infrastructure projects. Register and the operations team will confirm.
DriverPage.form_sub: Fill in the form and the operations team will contact within 24h to confirm your operating area and suitable trips.
DriverPage.form_c4: Nationwide support, priority for major project areas

AboutUs.meta_title: About Us | BenHub — Construction Logistics Platform
AboutUs.meta_desc: BenHub is Vietnam's leading construction logistics platform. Discover our story, mission, core values and the team behind the digital OS for construction transport.
AboutUs.hero_sub: BenHub was born from the operational pain points of Vietnam's construction logistics industry — where thousands of dump truck trips every day are still managed with paper slips and phone calls.
AboutUs.story_p1: During research and technology project deployments, BenHub's founding team discovered a major paradox: the construction industry — worth USD 60–80B per year — was still running on paper slips, phone calls, and Excel spreadsheets.
AboutUs.story_p2: Thousands of dump truck trips every day. Millions of handwritten transport slips. Receivables dragging 30–90 days. Material losses of 5–20% per project. No dashboards. No centralized data. Meanwhile, Grab has digitized taxis, Shopee has digitized e-commerce — construction transport has been largely left behind.
AboutUs.story_p3: BenHub was built to fill that gap.
AboutUs.tl_2026: Expansion to 6 provinces, 5,000+ vehicles, BenHub Mine launch
AboutUs.mv_mission_text: Use technology to bring transparency, efficiency, and modernization to construction transport
AboutUs.mv_vision_text: Become the leading Construction Logistics Operating System in Vietnam and ASEAN
AboutUs.mv_2035: Leading Construction Logistics OS in ASEAN
AboutUs.v1_desc: Every trip has verified data. Fraud is impossible when everything is recorded.
AboutUs.v2_desc: Optimize operations through technology and data. Every decision is fact-based, not intuition-driven.
AboutUs.v3_desc: Build a stable, trustworthy platform. Data is always accurate, systems always ready.
AboutUs.v4_desc: Continuously improve with AI and data. Technology is BenHub's long-term competitive advantage.
AboutUs.v5_desc: Build value for the entire industry chain. BenHub grows stronger as the ecosystem grows stronger.
AboutUs.eco_sub: BenHub isn't just a vehicle app — it's digital infrastructure covering the entire value chain from dispatch and management to finance.
AboutUs.prod3_desc: Site monitoring, load inspection, photo verification
AboutUs.team_sub: A founding team with deep experience in logistics operations, technology, and market development.
AboutUs.presence_sub: BenHub develops with a 'One Province – One Entity – One Local Ecosystem' model, combining central technology with local partner networks.
AboutUs.presence_model: Ownership model: BenHub Vietnam (51%) · Local partner (39%) · ESOP (10%)
AboutUs.join_sub: Whether you're a fleet owner, driver, investor, or contractor — BenHub has a place for you in this ecosystem.

HelpCenter.meta_desc: Frequently asked questions and support channels for BenHub drivers, partners, and customers.
HelpCenter.hero_sub: Find quick answers to common questions, or reach the BenHub operations team directly.
HelpCenter.faq_account_1_q: Who is this Help Center for?
HelpCenter.faq_account_1_a: Drivers, transport partners, contractors, and anyone learning about BenHub. Pick the right category below to find answers fastest.
HelpCenter.faq_account_2_q: I forgot my account password — what do I do?
HelpCenter.faq_account_2_a: Contact the hotline or support email below. Our operations team will verify your identity and restore access within one business day.
HelpCenter.faq_account_3_q: How does BenHub handle my personal data?
HelpCenter.faq_account_3_a: According to BenHub's Privacy Policy — see the full details on the Privacy Policy page linked in the site footer.
HelpCenter.faq_driver_1_a: Completely free. BenHub charges no registration fee. Just fill in the form and wait for the operations team to contact you.
HelpCenter.faq_driver_2_q: What type of driving license do I need?
HelpCenter.faq_driver_2_a: BenHub accepts drivers with a B2 license and above. C, D, F preferred for heavy trucks and dump trucks.
HelpCenter.faq_driver_3_q: How and when does BenHub pay?
HelpCenter.faq_driver_3_a: Each completed trip is auto-reconciled. BenHub Finance supports early advance or periodic payment as agreed.
HelpCenter.faq_partner_1_q: What does my business need to prepare to partner with BenHub?
HelpCenter.faq_partner_1_a: Just basic information about your fleet size or project. Our operations team will advise on the right solution once we receive your request.
HelpCenter.faq_partner_2_a: Yes. BenHub scales flexibly from small fleets to large infrastructure projects, based on actual operational needs.
HelpCenter.faq_partner_3_q: How long does it take to get a response after submitting a partnership request?
HelpCenter.faq_partner_3_a: BenHub's operations team responds within 1–2 business days of receiving your registration.
HelpCenter.contact_desc: The BenHub team is ready to support you through the following channels.
HelpCenter.faq_mine_1_a: BenHub Mine is quarry management software: licenses, extraction planning and output, digital weighbridge tickets, contracts, receivables, staff, attendance and payroll on one web and mobile platform.
HelpCenter.faq_mine_2_q: How do I try BenHub Mine?
HelpCenter.faq_mine_2_a: Fill in the trial form on the BenHub Mine page. Your password is emailed to you so you can sign in to the admin portal, and the BenHub team will reach out to advise and demo on your quarry's workflows.
HelpCenter.faq_mine_3_q: Do quarry drivers and workers need to install an app?
HelpCenter.faq_mine_3_a: Yes. Drivers use the app to accept trips, check in/out at the quarry and view tickets; workers use it to clock in and request leave. The office uses the web version. App install links are sent when your company registers for a trial.
